items.title: What's at stake for Paramount, the Ellisons in Warner Bros. takeover bid
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is facing some pushback from a collection of US attorneys general in its proposed acquisition of rival Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Evan Shapiro — better known as "The Media Cartographer" — comes on Market Domination Overtime to outline what is it at stake for the media giant and the Ellison family if the deal ultimately falls through.

items.title: California AG calls off Paramount settlement talks, accuses company of ‘playing games’
items.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta has canceled a meeting that was scheduled for Monday over Paramount’s planned $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery, CNN’s parent company.
